projects.name: World Cup Predictor
description: Built a 71.2% accurate Python ML pipeline that predicts FIFA World Cup 2026 match outcomes from 49K+ international matches spanning 336 national teams, with automated data ingestion, feature engineering, training, and inference.
Engineered 17 point-in-time features and trained an XGBoost model evaluated on a 2,245-match temporal holdout.

projects.name: AutoVert
description: Led development of a cross-platform AI-powered mobile app that performs intelligent vehicle diagnostics and repair cost estimation using GPT-4 and Gemini AI.
Architected a Clean-Architecture Flutter system integrating Firebase, Google Maps, and multimodal input (text, image, voice) for 90% diagnostic accuracy.

projects.name: Open Signal
description: Built a web platform that detects high-conviction insider trades from SEC Form 4 filings using a LightGBM scoring model with interpretable features.
Designed a FastAPI-based backend and React frontend for real-time alerts, achieving top-decile alpha of 5% in historical backtests.

projects.name: CliquePix
description: Developed a privacy-first photo and video sharing web app for close friends with per-media access control and AI-powered facial search.
Integrated TensorFlow.js and face-api.js for person recognition, backed by Node.js, Express, and MongoDB with secure bcrypt authentication.

projects.name: Brain Tumor Detection
description: Created a CNN-based medical imaging system to classify brain MRI scans as tumor or non-tumor with 90% accuracy.
Built an end-to-end pipeline using TensorFlow and Flask, allowing real-time predictions through an interactive web interface with secure file uploads.

projects.name: Customer Churn Prediction
description: Implemented a neural-network model in TensorFlow to predict customer churn in telecom data with 79% accuracy.
Engineered data pipelines with Pandas and Scikit-learn for preprocessing, encoding, and feature scaling, uncovering key churn indicators such as tenure and contract type.

projects.name: ML From Scratch
description: Developed a comprehensive educational ML library implementing core algorithms—Linear/Logistic Regression, SVM, Decision Trees, K-Means, and GANs—entirely from scratch using NumPy and PyTorch.
Showcased deep mathematical understanding through manual gradient computations and optimization logic.

projects.name: AI Plays Flappy Bird
description: Designed an AI agent that learns to play Flappy Bird using the NEAT algorithm for neuroevolution.
Implemented the full physics engine and visualization in Pygame, evolving neural networks that achieved average scores of 30+ through reinforcement learning.
